scope: Focused sandbox bootstrap diagnosis verified with one diagnostic and one corrected startup. Not product parity or release qualification.

sandbox_startup.root_cause: SDK cross-spawn('opencode') resolved ~/.local/bin/opencode before the built fork because the Node directory preceded the engine directory. That CLI rejected API-managed reference config. PATH is now shim, fork, caller Node; Node remains explicitly pinned at ABI127. Launcher also previously accepted HTTP200 unavailable and lost logs on identity failure.
sandbox_startup.guard_evidence: Corrected up: API4098 status ready, engine4097 healthy PID69049 version 0.0.0-feature/electron-flutter-retirement-202609111544, MCP rhythm connected. record_engine_identity verified the listener executable equals ENGINE_BIN. Bootstrap 4/4 and guards 4/4 passed while sandbox running. No public dependency provisioning needed.
sandbox_startup.teardown: Both runtime directories removed via sandbox.sh down; evidence siblings survive. Post-down only unchanged live PID13141 on 4001/4002 and PID13155 on 4096, with unchanged packaged executable paths. Sandbox ports freed. No packet-capture or provider/plugin-functionality qualification claimed.

criteria.text: Pin caller/override Node and validate native ABI; PATH orders Keychain shim, built fork, then Node directory before system fallbacks. API invokes NODE_BIN and bare MCP node resolves the same Node; SDK bare opencode resolves the built fork.
criteria.reason: Real diagnostic captured wrong CLI configuration rejection and PATH resolution. Corrected launch engine identity/readiness and focused ABI/PATH regression passed on Node v22.23.0 ABI127.
criteria.limitations: No full application or provider qualification.

criteria.text: Pin absolute local MCP payload with fail-closed preflight; npm/Arborist launch uses explicit offline mode, loopback inert registry and sandbox-local cache; retain offline model build input and skip-install.
criteria.limitations: Static/environment guard, not packet capture or plugin functionality qualification.

criteria.text: Generate read-only synthetic SQLite through canonical initDb/migrations with fake workspace/admin/member/active session, disabled schedules/automations and local MCP config, without live source reads.

criteria.text: Reject malformed/unusable MCP structure before launch; require a nonempty local MCP object with nonempty string command arrays. Disable ambient promotion and omit inherited provider credentials from runtime_env.
criteria.limitations: Regression covers a local entry missing command, not exhaustive config schema or command safety. Environment evidence is bootstrap only.
